measuredToDesign.measured: .21/.22 mm low Z source features and connected carrier
measuredToDesign.implementation: Sixteen accessible .4–.6 mm bed-aligned runners in four independent carrier bays; deliberate stronger original redesign.

originalFeatures: side-inserted mirror shelves with double shouldered tongues
two windowed cheeks with four diagonal sockets
handheld open optical frame and center-ray visualization
retention: Craft adhesive required in four joints; shoulder contact is location, not positive retention
optics: Geometric ray law and unobstructed path checked; film flatness and actual optical image NOT tested. Mirror film and adhesive are external consumables.
